action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated (strength 0.84) with weak seasonality (0.15), unstable model rankings (Kendall tau 0.14), and 6 of 12 error-correlation groups carrying redundant models. A trimmed mean over the full 19-model pool is the natural fit: it captures the diversity that the unstable rankings demand, is robust to the correlated-error redundancy without needing to identify which model to drop, and avoids the high-variance weight estimation that only 3 validation windows permit. All pool-restricted strategies (5, 7, 9 models) scored 1.26–1.52, confirming that the full pool's breadth is valuable here. The margin to the runner-up (plain mean, 0.75) is statistically indistinguishable, and no alternative combination kind (median, DBA, meta-weights) improved on the trimmed mean.
